title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Covered Loan-to-Value Reduction by Collateral Protection Plan
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 worksheet benefit: the value-band reduction.** The covered loan-to-value percent is reduced according to the collateral protection plan on the contract's Collateral Protection Insurance tracking record. That plan is the vehicle-value band the tracking record carries.

| Collateral protection plan on the tracking record | Value-band reduction |
|---|---|
| CollateralGuard Plan A | 15 points |
| CollateralGuard Plan B | 15 points |
| CollateralGuard Plan C | 5 points |
| CollateralGuard Plan D | 5 points |
| any other plan | no reduction |
| no tracking record | no reduction |

The reduction is subtracted from the plan's highest covered loan-to-value percent before the covered limit is figured.

*Hypothetical case.* A tracking record on CollateralGuard Plan B takes 15 points off a covered percent of 150, leaving 135. A tracking record on CollateralGuard Plan E takes nothing off.
